info.name: Reservation Dogs
info.plot: “Reservation Dogs” è una commedia di mezz'ora che segue quattro adolescenti indigeni nell'Oklahoma rurale che rubano e risparmiano per andare nell'esotica, misteriosa e lontana terra della California. Per riuscirci dovranno risparmiare abbastanza soldi, superare in astuzia i drogati dello sfasciacarrozze ai confini della città e sopravvivere a una guerra per il territorio contro una gang rivale più forte.

seasons.plot: In season three, the Rez Dogs find themselves stranded in Cali and have to figure out their way back home. After making it back to Okern, Elora considers the idea of college, Bear comes across a conspiracy theorist named Maximus, Willie Jack grows more invested in healing her community, and Cheese, well, he still lives with his grandmother who’s not his grandmother. Meanwhile, the aunties, uncles and elders explore their pasts and try to heal old wounds.
